 October 25, 2026 8:28 AM • Public Records 
 News Release 
 Ziarre Cobbs 
 LEBANON – A Statewide Silver Alert has been declared for a Lebanon teenager. 
 The Lebanon Police Department is investigating the disappearance of Ziarre Cobbs , a 17-year-old black girl who is 5 feet 4 inches tall and weighs 140 pounds. She has brown hair and brown eyes, and was last seen wearing a tank top and light blue jeans. 
 Ziarre is missing from Lebanon , which is 28 miles northwest of downtown Indianapolis, and was last seen at 5 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 13. She is believed to be in danger and may require medical assistance.  
 If you have any information on Ziarre Cobbs , contact the Lebanon Police Department at (765) 482-8836 or 911.
